pages.title: File:Closer look at a roof with carvings.jpg

ObjectName.value: Closer look at a roof with carvings

Categories.value: GFDL|Taken with Canon EOS 550D|Cheong Fatt Tze Mansion|License migration redundant|Self-published work

ImageDescription.value: A closer look at the roof of the mansion, highlighting the intricate porcelain work masterfully created by craftsmen from China. The technique employed is a traditional 'cut and paste' also called 'Chien Nien'. Pieces of porcelain are broken from colored bowls and then cemented together.

Artist.value: Mahen Bala
